svg.title: N00-flow-map
svg.text: One coffee payment. Everyone is paid in the same second, once the table screen bears witness.

g.text: Click any box to open its screen

svg.text: Each bill pays whoever is clocked in, in the same receipt as the owner.
One bill covers the five words of the Real-World Money track
Whoever is on shift is paid
from the next bill, at once.
Thai variants of NC-02, NC-05, NC-06, NC-07, ND-02 and ND-04 open from the language switch on each of those screens.
